error[L0110]: parentheses after a call's `else` bind its error; write `else fallback` for the branch's value

6 |     r = if c then twice(fallback) else (fallback) end if

  = note: [1820]: `else (name)` after a call opens that call's recovery, even in an `if` arm
  = help: write `else fallback`
